d: The Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, is at the center of a major legal, religious, and political controversy over a stone pillar known as Deepathoon. Despite the Supreme Court’s interim order on November 20, 2026, allowing a lamp to be lit on the pillar during Karthigai Deepam, no lamp was lit there on November 24, even with 5,600 police personnel deployed. Is this pillar an ancient lamp post or a British-era Great Trigonometrical Survey marker? Watch this explainer to understand the 100-year-old temple-dargah dispute, the 1931 Privy Council ruling, and CM Vijay’s…
